title: Shapes and Numbers Song (Tiny Sparks original)

chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Count the sides, count the sides, / shapes have num-bers, yes it's true! / Count the cor-ners, one by one, / shapes and num-bers, so much fun!

v1.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v1.lyrics: A tri-an-gle has three straight sides, / three lit-tle cor-ners side by side. / Let's count the sides, one, two, and three, / so a tri-an-gle has three!

v2.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v2.lyrics: A square has four sides, all the same, / four lit-tle cor-ners like a frame. / Let's count the sides, one, two, three, four, / so a square has four, yes four!

v3.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v3.lyrics: A pen-ta-gon has five sides, look! / Like a lit-tle house in a book. / Count the sides, one, two, three, four, five, / so a pen-ta-gon has five!

v4.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v4.lyrics: A hex-a-gon has six sides too, / bus-y bees build them, yes it's true! / Count them, one, two, three, four, five, six, / so a hex-a-gon has six!

v5.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v5.lyrics: A cir-cle rolls a-round and round, / it has no sides, no cor-ners found. / Let's count the cor-ners, there are none, / the cir-cle has ze-ro, fun!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q1.lyrics: How ma-ny sides on a square? / Four!

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: How ma-ny sides on a cir-cle? / Ze-ro!

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Make a tri-an-gle with your hands, / now draw a square up in the air, / spin a-round just like a cir-cle, / jump like a star, one, two, three!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's count the sides slow-ly! / Tri-an-gle sides / Three! / Square has four sides / Four!
